tl AS (SELECT execution_candidate_id ec, from_state f, to_state t, occurred_at ts, DATEADD(minute,330,occurred_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ ist
       FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_STATE_TRANSITION_LOG WHERE NOT _FIVETRAN_DELETED AND occurred_at >= '2026-10-01'),
inst AS (SELECT ec, MIN(ts) t_act, MIN(ist) ist_act FROM tl WHERE t IN ('RATING_PENDING','CONNECTION_ACTIVE') GROUP BY 1 HAVING MIN(ist)::DATE = (SELECT yday FROM p)),
asg AS (SELECT tl.ec, MIN(tl.ts) t_asg FROM tl JOIN inst USING(ec) WHERE tl.t='TECHNICIAN_ASSIGNED' GROUP BY 1),
term AS (SELECT PARSE_JSON(payload):execution_candidate_id::STRING ec, PARSE_JSON(payload):slot_day::DATE slot_day

iec AS (SELECT execution_candidate_id ec, slot_date FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_EXECUTION_CANDIDATES WHERE _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY execution_candidate_id ORDER BY _fivetran_synced DESC)=1),

  SELECT i.ec, i.ist_act::DATE inst_day, HOUR(i.ist_act) inst_hour, COALESCE(term.slot_day, iec.slot_date) slot_day,

tl AS (SELECT execution_candidate_id ec, from_state f, to_state t, reason_code rc, occurred_at::TIMESTAMP_NTZ ts
       FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_STATE_TRANSITION_LOG WHERE NOT _FIVETRAN_DELETED AND occurred_at >= '2026-10-01'),
iec AS (SELECT execution_candidate_id ec, slot_date, csp_id FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_EXECUTION_CANDIDATES WHERE _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY execution_candidate_id ORDER BY _fivetran_synced DESC)=1),
rd AS (SELECT PARSE_JSON(payload):execution_candidate_id::STRING ec, created_at::TIMESTAMP_NTZ ts, PARSE_JSON(payload):original_slot_date::DATE orig, PARSE_JSON(payload):new_slot_date::DATE nw, PARSE_JSON(payload):source::STRING src
       FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.OUTBOX_RECORD WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-01' AND payload ILIKE '%ES_INSTALL_SLOT_AUTO_REDATED%'),
born AS (SELECT ec, MIN(ts) t_created FROM tl GROUP BY 1),
anchor AS (SELECT b.ec, GREATEST(w.t0, b.t_created) ta FROM born b, w WHERE b.t_created < w.t1),
st0 AS (SELECT a.ec, a.ta, MAX_BY(tl.t, tl.ts) state0 FROM anchor a JOIN tl ON tl.ec=a.ec AND tl.ts <= a.ta GROUP BY 1,2),

        FROM st0 s JOIN rd r ON r.ec=s.ec GROUP BY 1),
due AS (
  SELECT s.ec FROM st0 s JOIN iec i ON i.ec=s.ec LEFT JOIN rdx ON rdx.ec=s.ec, w
  WHERE s.state0 NOT IN ('CANCELLED_BY_UPSTREAM','CANCELLED_BY_CUSTOMER','INSTALLATION_REPORTED_FAILED','DECLINED','RATING_PENDING','CONNECTION_ACTIVE')
    AND COALESCE(rdx.last_before, rdx.first_after, i.slot_date) = w.yday

  SELECT d.ec,
    MAX(IFF(tl.f='AWAITING_CSP_ACCEPTANCE' AND tl.t IN ('AWAITING_TECHNICIAN_ASSIGNMENT','AWAITING_SLOT_PROPOSAL') AND tl.ts < w.t1,1,0)) acc_eod,
    MAX(IFF(tl.t='TECHNICIAN_ASSIGNED' AND tl.ts < w.t1,1,0)) asg_eod,
    MAX(IFF(tl.t='ARRIVED_AT_SITE' AND tl.ts < w.t1,1,0)) arr_eod,
    MAX(IFF(tl.t='RATING_PENDING' AND tl.ts < w.t1,1,0)) otp_eod,
    MAX(IFF(tl.t IN ('RATING_PENDING','CONNECTION_ACTIVE') AND tl.ts < w.t1,1,0)) inst_eod,
    MAX(IFF(tl.t IN ('RATING_PENDING','CONNECTION_ACTIVE'),1,0)) inst_ever,
    MAX_BY(IFF(tl.ts < w.t1, tl.t, NULL), IFF(tl.ts < w.t1, tl.ts, NULL)) state_eod,
    MAX_BY(IFF(tl.ts < w.t1, tl.rc, NULL), IFF(tl.ts < w.t1, tl.ts, NULL)) rc_eod
  FROM due d JOIN tl ON tl.ec=d.ec, w GROUP BY 1
),
moved AS (SELECT r.ec, MAX(1) moved_yday FROM rd r, w WHERE r.ts >= w.t0 AND r.ts < w.t1 AND r.src='CSP_RESCHEDULE' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN inst_eod=1 THEN 'Installed on the day'
       WHEN state_eod='INSTALLATION_REPORTED_FAILED' THEN 'CSP reported failure'
       WHEN state_eod='CANCELLED_BY_CUSTOMER' THEN 'Customer cancelled'
       WHEN state_eod='DECLINED' THEN 'CSP declined'
       WHEN state_eod='CANCELLED_BY_UPSTREAM' AND rc_eod='TIMEOUT_P41' THEN 'FPN expired, no response'
       WHEN state_eod='CANCELLED_BY_UPSTREAM' THEN 'System / ops cancelled'
       WHEN m.moved_yday=1 THEN 'Rescheduled to a later day'
       ELSE 'Still open at end of day' END day_outcome,
  acc_eod, asg_eod, arr_eod, otp_eod, inst_eod, inst_ever, COALESCE(IFF(inst_eod=0, rc_eod, NULL),'-') eod_rc,
  IFF(inst_eod=0, nt.note, NULL) note,
  COUNT(*) tasks, COUNT(DISTINCT i.csp_id) csps
FROM ev LEFT JOIN moved m USING(ec) LEFT JOIN iec i USING(ec) LEFT JOIN (SELECT execution_candidate_id ecx, LOWER(TRIM(failure_detail)) note FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_EXECUTION_CANDIDATES WHERE _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY execution_candidate_id ORDER BY _fivetran_synced DESC)=1) nt ON nt.ecx = ev.ec

-- Due-day funnel per IST day since 1 Aug 2026. A task is due on D if, when D began (or when the task was created, if later),
-- it was open and its slot day was D. The slot history is rebuilt from ES_INSTALL_SLOT_AUTO_REDATED events as time intervals.
WITH tl AS (SELECT execution_candidate_id ec, from_state f, to_state t, occurred_at::TIMESTAMP_NTZ ts FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_STATE_TRANSITION_LOG WHERE NOT _FIVETRAN_DELETED AND occurred_at >= '2026-07-01'),
born AS (SELECT ec, MIN(ts) t_created FROM tl GROUP BY 1),
iec AS (SELECT execution_candidate_id ec, slot_date FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_EXECUTION_CANDIDATES WHERE _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY execution_candidate_id ORDER BY _fivetran_synced DESC)=1),
rd AS (SELECT PARSE_JSON(payload):execution_candidate_id::STRING ec, created_at::TIMESTAMP_NTZ ts, PARSE_JSON(payload):original_slot_date::DATE orig, PARSE_JSON(payload):new_slot_date::DATE nw
       FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.OUTBOX_RECORD WHERE created_at >= '2026-07-25' AND payload LIKE '%"event_type":"ES_INSTALL_SLOT_AUTO_REDATED"%'),
rdo AS (SELECT rd.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ec ORDER BY ts) rn, LEAD(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY ec ORDER BY ts) nxt FROM rd),
iv AS (
  -- interval before the first redate (or the whole life if never redated)
  SELECT b.ec, b.t_created s_from, COALESCE(r.ts, '2100-01-01'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) s_to, COALESCE(r.orig, i.slot_date) slot
  FROM born b JOIN iec i ON i.ec=b.ec LEFT JOIN rdo r ON r.ec=b.ec AND r.rn=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.ec, r.ts, COALESCE(r.nxt, '2100-01-01'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ), r.nw FROM rdo r JOIN born b ON b.ec=r.ec
),
cand AS (
  SELECT iv.ec, iv.slot d, GREATEST(DATEADD(minute,-330, iv.slot::TIMESTAMP_NTZ), b.t_created) anchor, DATEADD(minute,-330, DATEADD(day,1,iv.slot)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) t1
  FROM iv JOIN born b ON b.ec=iv.ec
  WHERE iv.slot BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND DATEADD(day,-1, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::DATE)
),
due AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.ec, c.d, c.anchor, c.t1 FROM cand c JOIN iv ON iv.ec=c.ec AND iv.slot=c.d AND c.anchor >= iv.s_from AND c.anchor < iv.s_to
  WHERE c.anchor < c.t1
),
st AS (
  SELECT d.ec, d.d,
    MAX_BY(IFF(tl.ts <= d.anchor, tl.t, NULL), IFF(tl.ts <= d.anchor, tl.ts, NULL)) state0,
    MAX(IFF(tl.t IN ('AWAITING_TECHNICIAN_ASSIGNMENT','TECHNICIAN_ASSIGNED','ARRIVED_AT_SITE','RATING_PENDING','CONNECTION_ACTIVE') AND tl.ts < d.t1,1,0)) acc,
    MAX(IFF(tl.t='TECHNICIAN_ASSIGNED' AND tl.ts < d.t1,1,0)) asg,
    MAX(IFF(tl.t='ARRIVED_AT_SITE' AND tl.ts < d.t1,1,0)) arr,
    MAX(IFF(tl.t IN ('RATING_PENDING','CONNECTION_ACTIVE') AND tl.ts < d.t1,1,0)) inst
  FROM due d JOIN tl ON tl.ec=d.ec GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT d, COUNT(*) due, SUM(acc) accepted, SUM(asg) assigned, SUM(arr) arrived, SUM(inst) installed_on_day
FROM st WHERE COALESCE(state0,'ASSIGNED') NOT IN ('CANCELLED_BY_UPSTREAM','CANCELLED_BY_CUSTOMER','INSTALLATION_REPORTED_FAILED','DECLINED','RATING_PENDING','CONNECTION_ACTIVE')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1


-- and (day activity) --

-- Day's activity funnel: tasks reaching each step for the first time on each IST day, since 1 Aug 2026
WITH tl AS (SELECT execution_candidate_id ec, from_state f, to_state t, occurred_at::TIMESTAMP_NTZ ts FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_STATE_TRANSITION_LOG WHERE NOT _FIVETRAN_DELETED AND occurred_at >= '2026-07-25'),
firsts AS (
  SELECT ec,
    MIN(IFF(t='ASSIGNED' AND f IS NULL, ts, NULL)) t_offer,
    MIN(IFF(t='AWAITING_TECHNICIAN_ASSIGNMENT', ts, NULL)) t_ready,
    MIN(IFF(t='TECHNICIAN_ASSIGNED', ts, NULL)) t_asg,
    MIN(IFF(t='ARRIVED_AT_SITE', ts, NULL)) t_arr,
    MIN(IFF(t='RATING_PENDING', ts, NULL)) t_otp,
    MIN(IFF(t IN ('RATING_PENDING','CONNECTION_ACTIVE'), ts, NULL)) t_act
  FROM tl GROUP BY 1
),
ev AS (
  SELECT 'offered' step, DATEADD(minute,330,t_offer)::DATE d FROM firsts WHERE t_offer IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
  SELECT 'accepted', DATEADD(minute,330,t_ready)::DATE FROM firsts WHERE t_ready IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
  SELECT 'assigned', DATEADD(minute,330,t_asg)::DATE FROM firsts WHERE t_asg IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
  SELECT 'arrived', DATEADD(minute,330,t_arr)::DATE FROM firsts WHERE t_arr IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
  SELECT 'happy_code', DATEADD(minute,330,t_otp)::DATE FROM firsts WHERE t_otp IS NOT NULL UNION ALL
  SELECT 'installed', DATEADD(minute,330,t_act)::DATE FROM firsts WHERE t_act IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d, COUNT_IF(step='offered') offered, COUNT_IF(step='accepted') accepted, COUNT_IF(step='assigned') assigned, COUNT_IF(step='arrived') arrived, COUNT_IF(step='happy_code') happy_code, COUNT_IF(step='installed') installed
FROM ev WHERE d BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND DATEADD(day,-1, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::DATE)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1


-- and (bookings supposed to be installed) --

-- Bookings that were supposed to be installed on each slot day (IST), and what happened to them by now. One row per booking (connection) per slot day.
-- Supposed = a task of the booking was open with that slot day when the day began (or when created that day), or the booking was installed early for that slot day.
WITH tl AS (SELECT execution_candidate_id ec, from_state f, to_state t, occurred_at::TIMESTAMP_NTZ ts FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_STATE_TRANSITION_LOG WHERE NOT _FIVETRAN_DELETED AND occurred_at >= '2026-07-01'),
born AS (SELECT ec, MIN(ts) t_created FROM tl GROUP BY 1),
iec AS (SELECT execution_candidate_id ec, connection_id, slot_date, current_state, reason_code, created_at::TIMESTAMP_NTZ created_at FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_EXECUTION_CANDIDATES WHERE _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY execution_candidate_id ORDER BY _fivetran_synced DESC)=1),
rd AS (SELECT PARSE_JSON(payload):execution_candidate_id::STRING ec, created_at::TIMESTAMP_NTZ ts, PARSE_JSON(payload):original_slot_date::DATE orig, PARSE_JSON(payload):new_slot_date::DATE nw, PARSE_JSON(payload):source::STRING src
       FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.OUTBOX_RECORD WHERE created_at >= '2026-07-25' AND payload LIKE '%"event_type":"ES_INSTALL_SLOT_AUTO_REDATED"%'),
rdo AS (SELECT rd.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ec ORDER BY ts) rn, LEAD(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY ec ORDER BY ts) nxt FROM rd),
iv AS (
  SELECT b.ec, b.t_created s_from, COALESCE(r.ts, '2100-01-01'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) s_to, COALESCE(r.orig, i.slot_date) slot
  FROM born b JOIN iec i ON i.ec=b.ec LEFT JOIN rdo r ON r.ec=b.ec AND r.rn=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.ec, r.ts, COALESCE(r.nxt, '2100-01-01'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ), r.nw FROM rdo r JOIN born b ON b.ec=r.ec
),
cand AS (
  SELECT iv.ec, iv.slot d, GREATEST(DATEADD(minute,-330, iv.slot::TIMESTAMP_NTZ), b.t_created) anchor, DATEADD(minute,-330, DATEADD(day,1,iv.slot)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) t1
  FROM iv JOIN born b ON b.ec=iv.ec
  WHERE iv.slot BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND DATEADD(day,-1, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::DATE)
),
due_t AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.ec, c.d, c.anchor FROM cand c JOIN iv ON iv.ec=c.ec AND iv.slot=c.d AND c.anchor >= iv.s_from AND c.anchor < iv.s_to WHERE c.anchor < c.t1
),
due_open AS (
  SELECT d.ec, d.d FROM due_t d JOIN tl ON tl.ec=d.ec
  GROUP BY 1,2, d.anchor
  HAVING COALESCE(MAX_BY(IFF(tl.ts <= d.anchor, tl.t, NULL), IFF(tl.ts <= d.anchor, tl.ts, NULL)),'ASSIGNED') NOT IN ('CANCELLED_BY_UPSTREAM','CANCELLED_BY_CUSTOMER','INSTALLATION_REPORTED_FAILED','DECLINED','RATING_PENDING','CONNECTION_ACTIVE')
),
inst_t AS (SELECT ec, MIN(ts) t_act FROM tl WHERE t IN ('RATING_PENDING','CONNECTION_ACTIVE') GROUP BY 1),

  SELECT i.ec, iec.slot_date d FROM inst_t i JOIN iec ON iec.ec=i.ec
  WHERE DATEADD(minute,330,i.t_act)::DATE < iec.slot_date AND iec.slot_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND DATEADD(day,-1, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::DATE)
),
supp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT iec.connection_id conn, s.d FROM (SELECT ec, d FROM due_open UNION SELECT ec, d FROM early) s JOIN iec ON iec.ec=s.ec WHERE iec.connection_id IS NOT NULL
),
conn_inst AS (SELECT iec.connection_id conn, DATEADD(minute,330,MIN(i.t_act))::DATE inst_day FROM inst_t i JOIN iec ON iec.ec=i.ec GROUP BY 1),
conn_now AS (SELECT connection_id conn, MAX_BY(current_state, created_at) state_now, MAX_BY(slot_date, created_at) slot_now, MAX_BY(reason_code, created_at) rc_now FROM iec WHERE connection_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1),
moved AS (SELECT DISTINCT iec.connection_id conn, r.orig d FROM rd r JOIN iec ON iec.ec=r.ec WHERE r.src='CSP_RESCHEDULE' AND r.nw > r.orig),
x AS (
  SELECT s.conn, s.d, ci.inst_day, cn.state_now, cn.slot_now, cn.rc_now, IFF(m.conn IS NULL,0,1) moved
  FROM supp s LEFT JOIN conn_inst ci ON ci.conn=s.conn LEFT JOIN conn_now cn ON cn.conn=s.conn LEFT JOIN moved m ON m.conn=s.conn AND m.d=s.d
)
SELECT d,
  CASE WHEN inst_day < d THEN 'Installed early'
       WHEN inst_day = d THEN 'Installed on the day'
       WHEN inst_day > d AND moved=1 THEN 'Rescheduled, installed later'
       WHEN inst_day > d THEN 'Late, installed later'
       WHEN state_now = 'CANCELLED_BY_CUSTOMER' THEN 'Customer cancelled'
       WHEN state_now = 'CANCELLED_BY_UPSTREAM' AND rc_now = 'TIMEOUT_P41' THEN 'No CSP accepted in time'
       WHEN state_now = 'DECLINED' THEN 'CSP declined'
       WHEN state_now IN ('INSTALLATION_REPORTED_FAILED','INSTALLATION_CANCELLED_ONSITE','WITHDRAWN_BY_CSP') THEN 'CSP reported failure'
       WHEN state_now IN ('CANCELLED_BY_UPSTREAM','INSTALLATION_EXPIRED') THEN 'Dropped by system'
       WHEN state_now IN ('ASSIGNED','AWAITING_CSP_ACCEPTANCE') THEN 'Still finding a CSP'
       WHEN moved=1 OR slot_now > d THEN 'Rescheduled, not installed yet'
       ELSE 'Overdue, still open' END outcome,
  IFF(inst_day > d, LEAST(DATEDIFF(day, d, inst_day), 4), NULL) days_late,
  COUNT(*) bookings
FROM x GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

iec AS (SELECT execution_candidate_id ec, slot_date FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_EXECUTION_CANDIDATES WHERE _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY execution_candidate_id ORDER BY _fivetran_synced DESC)=1),

yd=daily[-1]; prior=daily[:-1]
M=[ # field, name, direction(+1 higher better,-1 lower better,0 neutral), unit, min_start, what it means
 ('installs','Installs done','+','int','2026-08-01','installations completed during the day'),
 ('x_pct','On time, never rescheduled','+','pct','2026-09-18','share of installs on or before the slot day with no reschedule'),
 ('y_pct','Rescheduled (any outcome)','-','pct','2026-09-18','share of installs whose date the CSP moved before installing'),
 ('z_pct','Late, never rescheduled','-','pct','2026-09-18','share of installs after the slot day with no reschedule'),
 ('late_pct','All late installs','-','pct','2026-09-18','share of installs after the slot day'),
 ('due','Tasks due','0','int','2026-11-03','open tasks whose slot day was the day'),
 ('due_to_accepted_pct','Due → accepted by CSP','+','pct','2026-11-03','share of due tasks the CSP had accepted by midnight'),
 ('due_to_assigned_pct','Due → technician assigned','+','pct','2026-11-03','share of due tasks with a technician by midnight'),
 ('assigned_to_arrived_pct','Technician assigned → reached customer home','+','pct','2026-08-01','share of due tasks with a technician that reached the customer home that day'),
 ('arrived_to_installed_pct','Reached customer home → installed','+','pct','2026-08-01','share of home visits that ended in an install that day'),
 ('assigned_to_installed_pct','Technician assigned → installed on the day','+','pct','2026-08-01','share of due tasks with a technician installed that day'),
 ('due_to_installed_pct','Due → installed on the day','+','pct','2026-11-03','share of all due tasks installed that day'),
 ('act_assigned','Technicians assigned during the day','+','int','2026-08-01','tasks that got a technician that day'),
 ('act_arrived','Customer homes reached during the day','+','int','2026-08-01','tasks where the technician reached the customer home that day'),
 ('act_installed_per_assigned_pct','Installs ÷ technicians assigned (same day)','+','pct','2026-08-01','installs done that day as a share of technicians assigned that day'),
 ('pr_on_time_pct','Bookings due that day installed on time','+','pct','2026-08-01','share of bookings supposed to be installed that day that were installed on or before it'),
]
